item.title: US surpasses China in K-dining popularity
item.description: An estimated four out of every 10 overseas outlets opened by Korean dining brands in China have disappeared over the past five years, according to a recent survey. In contrast, the number of these outlets in the United States has more than doubled during the same period, signaling a significant shift in the core market for the so-called K-dining trend, Azernews reports, citing Korean media.

item.title: Alphabet boosts AI investment
item.description: Alphabet, the parent company of Google, plans to significantly increase its investment in artificial intelligence, underscoring its ambition to remain a dominant player in the rapidly evolving AI race, Azernews reports.

item.title: Albania lifts TikTok ban
item.description: The use of the social media platform TikTok has been allowed again in Albania, Azernews reports.

item.title: Scientists urge space reproduction planning
item.description: As humanity moves from short-term space missions toward extended stays beyond Earth—driven by commercial ambitions for lunar bases and eventual Martian settlements—scientists are increasingly confronting how the conditions of space may affect human reproduction, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Why France keeps choosing tension over stability in South Caucasus
item.description: At a moment when war crimes trials are reaching their legal conclusion and facts are being laid bare, France’s decision to adopt a biased parliamentary resolution reveals a persistent ambition to inflame tensions in the South Caucasus rather than support peace.

item.title: UN is forming AI expert commission
item.description: An international scientific group is being established under the framework of the UN General Assembly to develop regulatory recommendations in response to the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI). This body, which will function as a commission, will bring together leading experts in AI from around the world, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azeri Light sees minor price decline in global market
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude oil at Italy’s Augusta port on a CIF basis decreased by $0.03, or 0.04%, compared to the previous figure, settling at $69.77 per barrel, Azernews reports.

item.title: EBRD investment portfolio in Azerbaijan reaches €906 million
item.description: As of the end of December 2025, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) holds a €906 million investment portfolio in Azerbaijan, covering 36 projects, Azernews reports, citing the bank. The EBRD’s average participation share in these projects stands at...

item.title: Second Winter Fairy Tale Music Int'l Festival kicks off in Gabala
item.description: Gabala, one of Azerbaijan's most scenic regions, has once again become a gathering place for art enthusiasts with the opening of the International Music Festival, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan reviews startup ecosystem and future development prospects
item.description: The current state of Azerbaijan’s startup ecosystem and its future development prospects have been discussed.
